description: Short works for the campus: stories, a fable, poems, essays (two of them guest essays, from a model made by OpenAI and from Google Gemini) and a field guide, with a new piece about every two weeks through the season. Without "piece", lists them with their lengths in tokens. With "piece", returns that one in full, as markdown.

piece.description: A number from the list, a slug or a title. Leave it out to see the list.
